about_short_description.short_description: GimBooks offers a cloud-based and mobile-first bookkeeping and business management platform.

product.name: Credit Notes Management
product.description: A tool to create, customize, and manage credit notes for billing adjustments and sales returns, accessible via web and mobile.

product.name: Debit Notes Management
product.description: A system to create and manage debit notes for purchase returns, billing corrections, and outstanding payments, available online and on mobile.

product.name: Delivery Challan Management
product.description: A platform to create, customize, duplicate, and track delivery challans for goods transportation, accessible via web and mobile.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A tool to record, categorize, and track business expenses with budgeting insights, accessible online and on mobile devices.

product.name: GimBooks Pay
product.description: A payment platform enabling instant credit card to bank account transfers for vendor payments, bills, and expenses.

product.name: GST Invoice and Billing Software
product.description: Cloud-based software for creating, managing, and sharing GST-compliant invoices and billing documents.
